title: The MarkdownViewer pattern specifies a composition its demo no longer shows
foundBy: an independent reviewer agent, asked to assess whether the patterns had drifted from the design system

evidence.verified: `npm run ci` exits 0. `patterns/MarkdownViewer.md` now opens on the flavour ladder the tab renders, names `?flavor=<slug>` and the six rungs, and labels the three-pane example as the Docs page's composition. The internals it restated, the outline width range and the 50ms scroll debounce among them, are a link to `components/MarkdownViewer.md` instead.

details:
`patterns/MarkdownViewer.md` specifies a three-pane composition of SplitPane, Panel, Tree and a viewer with outline and minimap. The demo shows a six-flavour bundle-cost ladder instead, and says so in its own comment: the three-pane composition moved to the Docs page.

So the tab and the specification are two unrelated documents about the same name. A reader who opens one and then reads the other finds nothing in common.

The flavour ladder is the more useful thing to document, because choosing a parser flavour is the real decision a consumer faces. The three-pane example is worth keeping, labelled as the Docs page composition.

Secondary: the spec duplicates internals that already live in `components/MarkdownViewer.md`, including the outline widths and the scroll debounce. They agree today, so this is duplication rather than contradiction, against CONTRIBUTING's rule that every fact lives in one place.

notes.text: Closed at the smaller of the two scopes the record set out. The flavour ladder is documented and the three-pane example is kept and labelled, rather than the demo being rebuilt to match the old specification. The owner confirmed that scope.
